task: Zotero is installed and a pre-seeded library is at /home/user/Zotero/zotero.sqlite. Launch Zotero. Locate the item titled 'A Survey of RL Methods' (currently has a single author, Sutton) and select it. Add a SECOND author with first name exactly 'Andrew' and last name exactly 'Barto'. Make sure the existing Sutton author remains. After saving, the item must have exactly 2 creators total: Sutton and Barto. Leave Zotero running.

cli_feasibility.translation: Python script using SQLite: 1) Find item by title, 2) Insert new creator into creators table, 3) Link creator to item via itemCreators table with creatorType='author'
cli_feasibility.reason: Zotero stores creator data in SQLite tables (creators, itemCreators). A Python script can directly insert a new creator record and link it to the item. The database schema supports multiple creators per item, making this operation straightforward via SQL INSERT statements.
